fragments.probe:
validateProbeQuote mSf qq = do
        validateQuantityInput Nothing qq
        validateMinimumNotional (mSf >>= sfMinNotional)
        if qq <= 0
            then Left "Quote is 0."
            else case mSf >>= sfMinNotional of
                Just mn | qq < mn -> Right mn
                _ -> Right qq

    normalizeProbeQty mSf mPrice qtyRaw = do
        validateQuantityInput (fmap (\st -> (stepScale st, stepInt st)) (mSf >>= effectiveStep)) qtyRaw
        validateSizingInputs (mSf >>= effectiveMinQty) (mSf >>= effectiveMaxQty) (mSf >>= sfMinNotional) mPrice
        case mSf of
            Nothing ->
                if qtyRaw > 0
                    then Right qtyRaw
                    else Left "Quantity is 0."
            Just sf -> do
                let qty0 = max 0 qtyRaw
                    qty1 = maybe qty0 (`quantizeDown` qty0) (effectiveStep sf)
                    qty2 =
                        case (mPrice, sfMinNotional sf) of
                            (Just price, Just mn)
                                | price > 0 && qty1 * price < mn ->
                                    let minQ = mn / price
                                     in maybe minQ (`quantizeUp` minQ) (effectiveStep sf)
                            _ -> qty1
                validateQuantityInput Nothing qty2
                if qty2 <= 0
                    then Left "Quantity rounds to 0."
                    else case effectiveMinQty sf of
                        Just minQ | qty2 < minQ -> Left ("Quantity below minQty (" ++ show minQ ++ ").")
                        _ ->
                            case effectiveMaxQty sf of
                                Just maxQ | qty2 > maxQ -> Left ("Quantity above maxQty (" ++ show maxQ ++ ").")
                                _ ->
                                    case (mPrice, sfMinNotional sf) of
                                        (Just price, Just mn) | price > 0 && qty2 * price < mn -> Left ("Notional below minNotional (" ++ show mn ++ ").")
                                        _ -> Right qty2
fragments.sizing:
effectiveStep sf = sfMarketStepSize sf <|> sfLotStepSize sf
    effectiveMinQty sf = sfMarketMinQty sf <|> sfLotMinQty sf
    effectiveMaxQty sf = sfMarketMaxQty sf <|> sfLotMaxQty sf

    stepValue :: Step -> Double
    stepValue st = fromIntegral (stepInt st) / fromIntegral (stepScale st)

    quantizeUp :: Step -> Double -> Double
    quantizeUp st = quantizeUpExact (stepScale st) (stepInt st)

    minTradeQty :: SymbolFilters -> Double -> Maybe Double
    minTradeQty sf price =
        let minQ = fromMaybe 0 (effectiveMinQty sf)
            stepQ = maybe 0 stepValue (effectiveStep sf)
            notionalQ =
                case sfMinNotional sf of
                    Just mn | price > 0 -> mn / price
                    _ -> 0
            minRaw = max minQ (max stepQ notionalQ)
            minAdj =
                case effectiveStep sf of
                    Just st -> quantizeUp st minRaw
                    Nothing -> minRaw
         in if minAdj > 0 then Just minAdj else Nothing

    minTradeQtyMaybe :: Maybe SymbolFilters -> Double -> Maybe Double
    minTradeQtyMaybe mSf price = mSf >>= \sf -> minTradeQty sf price

    isLongSpot :: Maybe SymbolFilters -> Double -> Double -> Bool
    isLongSpot mSf price baseBal =
        case minTradeQtyMaybe mSf price of
            Just minQ -> baseBal >= minQ
            Nothing -> baseBal > 0

    isTooSmallQtyError :: String -> Bool
    isTooSmallQtyError msg =
        msg == "Quantity rounds to 0."
            || "Quantity below minQty" `isPrefixOf` msg
            || "Notional below minNotional" `isPrefixOf` msg

    normalizeQty :: SymbolFilters -> Double -> Double -> Either String Double
    normalizeQty sf price qtyRaw = do
        validateQuantityInput (fmap (\st -> (stepScale st, stepInt st)) (effectiveStep sf)) qtyRaw
        validateSizingInputs (effectiveMinQty sf) (effectiveMaxQty sf) (sfMinNotional sf) (Just price)
        let qty0 = max 0 qtyRaw
            qty1 = maybe qty0 (`quantizeDown` qty0) (effectiveStep sf)
         in if qty1 <= 0
                then Left "Quantity rounds to 0."
                else case effectiveMinQty sf of
                    Just minQ | qty1 < minQ -> Left ("Quantity below minQty (" ++ show minQ ++ ").")
                    _ ->
                        case effectiveMaxQty sf of
                            Just maxQ | qty1 > maxQ -> Left ("Quantity above maxQty (" ++ show maxQ ++ ").")
                            _ ->
                                case sfMinNotional sf of
                                    Just mn | price > 0 && qty1 * price < mn -> Left ("Notional below minNotional (" ++ show mn ++ ").")
                                    _ -> Right qty1

    normalizeEntryQty :: SymbolFilters -> Double -> Double -> Either String (Double, Bool)
    normalizeEntryQty sf price qtyRaw =
        case normalizeQty sf price qtyRaw of
            Right q -> Right (q, False)
            Left err ->
                if not (isTooSmallQtyError err)
                    then Left err
                    else case minTradeQty sf price of
                        Nothing -> Left err
                        Just minQ ->
                            case normalizeQty sf price minQ of
                                Right qMin -> Right (qMin, qMin > qtyRaw + 1e-9)
                                Left _ -> Left err
